Competing Model (H2): Central bank standing repo facility backstops provide an elastic liquidity relief valve, effectively truncating downside tail risks and anchoring overnight funding rates for {entities} within target bands.

Competing Model (H2): Private corporate cash reserves and equity issuance capacity buffer against short-term financing friction in {entities}, averting broader debt defaults despite elevated policy benchmark rates.

Competing Model (H2): Forward guidance communication and macroprudential forbearance alleviate dealer balance sheet constraints, stabilizing {entities} secondary market trading without direct monetary expansion.
